text:
dez: Quick sync  CISO asked for an audit-export cost cut across eu-west + eu-central. The ask: reduce noisy keystore/KMS enrichments + flow-blobs. They floated dynamic sampling tied to GPU-pool health rather than flat percent. Thoughts?

hana: Dynamic sampling sounds interesting. How would it interact with recent firewall tightening? If sampling drops during a firewall-induced spike we could lose the signals that explain GPU join regressions.

dez: Exactly the worry. Instead of blanket 10% i'd propose: baseline 25% for noisy events, but if any GPU pool reports join-failure-rate > 1% or keystore_decrypt_error_rate > 0.25% then flip that pool to 100% emit for 30m. That keeps forensic fidelity when the fleet is unstable.

omar: Ops constraints: we can implement that as a small controller that watches Prom metrics and patches the telemetry configmap per-az. Rough CLI to toggle per-pool: 
````
# enable dynamic sampling for eu-west-a pool
kubectl -n infra-telemetry patch configmap audit-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"eu-west-a.dynamic_sampling":"true"}}'
````

jyoti: Telemetry side: we'll need two Prom rules + one alertmanager automation: 1) `keystore_decrypt_error_rate{region="eu-west",pool="eu-west-a"}` 2) `gpu_pool_join_fail_rate`. If either crosses threshold, alert fires and a webhook toggles sampling to 1.0 for that pool. Add a Grafana panel showing sampled vs raw events so we can eyeball loss of signal.

hana: Nice. What about compliance? Auditors will want to know exactly which event types are ever sampled. I recommend a whitelist: never sample events with fields `user_token`, `grant_id`, `cross_account`, `admin_action`, `iam_policy_change`. Document that in the compliance memo.

dez: Agreed. Also ops note: before rolling sampling, try exporter-level compression + dedupe in eu-west. In our us-west test enabling snappy + coarse dedupe dropped payload ~35% without any sampling. Less risk. Omar, can infra try that in eu-west-staging?

omar: Yes, i'll run an exporter benchmark today. If compression yields >25% reduction we can reduce scope of sampling. I'll post numbers.

jyoti: Runbook sketch:
1) snapshot current raw exports to short-term s3://audit-hot/<region>/pre-sample-<ts>
2) enable dynamic_sampling on canary pool eu-west-a at 25%
3) Deploy prometheus rules + webhook for auto-revert
4) Monitor 48h, if stable drop noisy class to 15%
5) If webhook triggers, controller sets pool->100% for 30m and pages oncall
Commands: 
````
# snapshot (one-off)
aws s3 cp s3://audit-live/eu-west/ s3://audit-hot/eu-west/pre-sample-7123456789/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "keystore/*" 
# toggle sampling
kubectl -n infra-telemetry patch cm audit-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"eu-west-a.keystore.sampling":"0.25"}}'
````

ops-oncall: I'll draft the full rollback and rehydration steps. Important: rehydration could be slow (multi-TB) so include an analysis window request form for compliance if raw logs are needed for an investigation. Also add a synthetic decrypt probe: `curl -fsS https://keystore-canary.eu-west-a/decrypt -d @test` every 30s, fail 3 -> revert.

hana: Safety question: who can flip the dynamic controller? Add RBAC so only infra owners and security ops can toggle. Also log every toggle to the audit plane (separate from sampled events).

dez: Good call. I'll include RBAC and an immutable audit entry requirement in the ticket. Audit-bot, please open a policy ticket with owners and timeline.

audit-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-9999. Assignees: dez (owner), omar (exporter bench), jyoti (telemetry/controller), ops-oncall (runbook). Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-9999

omar: I'll run compression + dedupe in staging and post payload numbers by EOD. If we get >30% we can prefer exporter changes over sampling.

jyoti: I'll prototype the controller and webhook automation in a feature branch and test the auto-revert path in staging.

ops-oncall: I'll prepare the synthetic probes, S3 snapshot job, and the rollback playbook. Plan to test end-to-end in staging tomorrow.

dez: Summary action items: dez -> policy + RBAC note; omar -> exporter benchmark; jyoti -> prometheus + controller + dashboards; ops-oncall -> runbook + probes + snapshot job. We will not change production sampling until staging canary passes and compliance signs off. Meet 09:30 UTC tomorrow to approve canary. :thumbsup:
